goal: Build an isolated Windows x64 Operator Console over the existing WoW112 runtime: structured event/state/history views, existing IPC telemetry, live SummonScout whisper observation and explicitly routed manual whisper commands, without reimplementing login/world/AH/summon/business logic or exposing economic mutation bypasses.
shared_resources: SummonScout whisper observer and manual-send transport
notes: Feature is intentionally isolated from feature/ah-auction-lifecycle-v1. AutoLoginBridge changes are transport-only and preserve existing login/retry/hot-watch semantics. Native command protocol exposes whisper only; BUY/CANCEL/POST/MAIL are absent. Manual whisper uncertain outcomes are hard-stopped with no automatic retry. No automatic integration into parallel is requested.
